source.notes: POST /sap/bc/adt/debugger/watchpoints?variableName=LV_TOTAL, empty request body — the variable name is passed entirely in the query string. Answers 200 with the <dbg:watchpoints> LIST root (not a single <watchpoint> root) containing one new row: id="1", kind="local", procedure="IF_OO_ADT_CLASSRUN~MAIN", oldValue and currentValue both "0 " (note the ABAP I-type trailing sign column) since the watchpoint was armed before LV_TOTAL had been assigned on this pass. Captured against the $TMP probe class ZCL_I89_PROBE, suspended in IF_OO_ADT_CLASSRUN~MAIN, before it reached the DO 5 TIMES loop that increments LV_TOTAL. The response's own adtcomp:templateLink for "Modify" is /sap/bc/adt/debugger/watchpoints/1{?condition,active} — a PUT to that template was never exercised by this capture run, so its shape is not verified here. Redactions performed by the capture harness before this file was written: appliance host -> 203.0.113.10:50000 (RFC 5737), application-server hostname -> a4hsandbox, Authorization/Cookie/set-cookie header values stripped. sha256/byteLength in the source .meta.json are computed over the redacted body as stored.
